name: Jerry Brown
summary: Jerry Brown is a Democrat who served four terms as California governor, as well as Attorney General and mayor of Oakland. As governor he combined aggressive climate policy, a higher minimum wage and prison realignment with budget caution and a preference for local control and consensus.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Brown signed SB 3, raising the state minimum wage to $15 by 2022.

collective-bargaining.rationale: As governor in 1975 he signed the Agricultural Labor Relations Act, giving farm workers secret-ballot representation elections and bargaining rights.

limit-guns.rationale: He signed six gun bills in 2016 (magazine turn-in, ammunition background checks) and vetoed five others, a mixed record.

death-penalty.rationale: In 1977 he vetoed a bill to reinstate the death penalty (overridden by the legislature).

rehabilitation.rationale: He signed AB 109 to end the revolving door through state prisons, citing that it thwarts rehabilitation.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: As Attorney General he filed a brief urging the California Supreme Court to overturn Prop 8 because the right to marry covers same-sex couples.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: He signed SB 32 (40 percent cut below 1990 levels by 2030) and AB 197 and a 2018 order and law for carbon neutrality and 100 percent clean electricity.

human-caused-global-warming.rationale: In his 2018 State of the State he said the science is not in doubt and that human-caused greenhouse gases are trapping heat.

decide-locally.rationale: His AB 109 realignment moved responsibility for lower-level offenders from the state to counties.

open-borders.rationale: In a 2007 interview he said migrants must be regularized and that you cannot just leave the borders open.

results-over-ideology.rationale: In his 2011 inaugural he asked officials to rise above ideology and partisan interest and find what the good of California requires.

political-decisions-consensus.rationale: In 2017 he said history tells us to find consensus and build coalitions as the nature of democratic government.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: In 2015 he stressed living within our means and a balanced budget; he said nothing about stimulus spending specifically.
